b1.claim: MIDV test split is strictly disjoint by document type from train/valid with no near-duplicates (Hamming <= 6).
b1.explanation_of_perfect_metric: 300 test photos each contain exactly 1 centered, prominent card on a flat background. RF-DETR 32M localized 300/300 cleanly.
b1.verdict: VERIFIED (clean document-type split on MIDV-2020), but WEAK on unconstrained in-the-wild variability.

b2.claim: Card detector passes recall>=0.95, precision>=0.90, neg FP<=0.05, and scale stress 2x>=0.90, 3x>=0.60.
b2.verdict: WEAK — Scale-stress diagnostic failed (2x: 44.33% vs 90%, 3x: 9.67% vs 60%). Fix needed in Phase C1.

b3.claim: Visual forensics achieves ROC AUC 1.0000 on face-swap, text inpaint, and copy-move manipulations.
b3.data_source_truth: Images in Phase 8 benchmark were procedurally generated in RAM by PIL (eval/forensics_benchmark.py: create_procedural_card).
b3.explanation: Perfect 1.0000 AUC was measured strictly on synthetic PIL mockups with artificial splice/inpaint boundaries. Has NOT been validated on real IDNet or FantasyID captures.
b3.verdict: SYNTHETIC-ONLY (WEAK). Needs validation on real IDNet-2025 / FantasyID datasets (Phase C/D).

b4.claim: MRZ detector achieves 1.0000 recall and improves end-to-end OCR check-digit valid rate.
b4.verdict: WEAK on production OCR target (20.67% beats baseline 2.0%, but is far below production target >= 60%). Fix needed in Phase C2.

b5.claim: DocType v2 achieves 99.69% accuracy across 8 classes.
b5.verdict: WEAK — 5 of 8 document classes are trained and tested strictly on synthetic mockups. Fix needed in Phase C3.

b6.claim: Full detection chains meet <= 900 ms latency budget on 2-thread CPU server.
b6.verdict: VERIFIED on local 2-thread CPU. Space/Container measurement to verify in Phase F.

b7.documentation_fix: Removed all 'Zero fabricated' promotional phrasing and replaced with precise evidence tables.
